items.title: Bind private endpoint update and delete to the HorizonDB cluster parent
items.summary: The routes.tsp group adds HorizonDbCluster as the parent argument of the private endpoint CustomPatchAsync and DeleteAsync template applications. These are the update and deletion lifecycle operations for a cluster's private endpoint connection, not a version publication. For the existing 2026-01-20-preview comparison, both routes move beneath clusters/{clusterName} and gain a required clusterName input; update also returns the PrivateEndpointConnectionResource SDK model instead of the common PrivateEndpointConnection model. Polling links, completion states, and final-result members otherwise remain equivalent. The supplied source-file grouping is retained without asserting a wider business feature.
